tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal tshogs kyi bdag po chags pa'i rdo rje gtso 'khor bzhi'i rjes gnang gi phyag gzhes gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs so// ༄༅// zla ba'i sku can dpal 'byor 'dod 'jo'i dpal// skyon kun spangs kyi rjes chags bde ba'i sku// dngos grub nor bu'i bang mdzod tshogs kyi bdag /lha chen chags pa rdo rjes 'gro 'di skyongs// 'dir jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i tshogs bdag dkar po chags pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug gtso 'khor bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi phyag gzhes la/ gnas dben par tshogs bdag gi sku yod na dgram/ de'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal gyi khar/ rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po'i steng dbus su gaḥyig dkar po zhig bris pa'am/ yang na tshon spungs dkar po che ba gcig de'i mdun du tshon spungs dmar po phyi nas cung zad byugs pa dbus ma las chung ba/ de'i mdun du tshon spungs dmar ser de las cung zad chung ba gnyis gshibs nas bsham/ bsdu na tshom bu bzhi maṇ+ḍal steng du tshon spungs kyi rim pa ltar dgod/ de'i g.yas su thod chang dang mdun du zho mar gyis sbrus pa'i gtor ma dkar po gru bzhi pa mtho gang tsam/ gtor ma dngos gzhi la mar dkar bzhus pa'i khu bas byugs pa rtse rgyan dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ gnas gsum du byug rgyu'i gi waṃ tsan+dan dmar po bsres pa'i phyi ma'am/ sin+dhu ra zhig kyang maṇ+ḍal dang nye bar bzhag de nas slob dpon gyis phyag rdor 'byung po 'dul byed dam phyag rdor gyi rigs gang yang rung ba zhig gi bsgom bzlas byas nas/ mdun gyi rdul tshon tshom bu la dmigs nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gaḥdakar po las dpal tshogs kyi bdag po chags pa rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal glang po che/ g.yas byi ba/ g.yon spre'u'i zhal/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum gyis rdo rje/ la phug ral gri/

g.yon gsum gyis la du dang*/ chang gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dgra s+t+wa rnams 'dzin pa/ zhabs phyi ma gnyis cung zad brkyang zhing bskum pa/ nang ma gnyis bsnol ba/ khu ba 'dren pa'i 'dug stangs byas nas/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ pad+ma'i ga sha can gcer bur bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun na byang sems 'bebs pa'i lha mo dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gyen du bstan nas yab kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje'i phyed tsam zhal du tshud nas 'jib pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang ut+pal sngon po'i ga sha can/ yab kyi zhabs phyi ma gnyis lha mo'i phyag gnyis kyis 'degs pa/ zhabs nang ma gnyis yum gyi dpung pa'i steng na yod pa/ yum gyi zhabs gnyis chags pa'i tshul gyis bgrad pa/ sku sha rgyas shing nu ma dang ldan pa/ spre'u'i dbu can/ yum gyi zhabs gnyis spre'u dmar po la ser po'i mdangs dang ldan pa gnyis kyi mgo bo mnan pa/ de gnyis kyi lag par bum pa bzang po bzed pa'i nang du yum gyi mkha' nas rin po che'i char 'bebs pas bum pa gang nas sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster ba/ de gnyis kyi 'og tu pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ de dag gi mtha' skor du bum pa bzang po dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang*/ rtags brgyad dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba dang*/ rin po che'i gter la sogs pa lha mi'i dpal dang 'byor pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba/ gtso 'khor bzhi'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i dbus su gaḥyig shel dkar dwangs pa'i mdangs can/ slob dpon phyag rdor du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar phog thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po dang dmar ser la sogs pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa'i tshul can dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas tshogs bdag gtso 'khor bzhi la nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs kyis bskor ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs mdun bskyed la bstim/ oṃ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje// gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// tshogs rje tshogs bdag dbang gi bdag /bgegs kyi gtso la mchod cing bstod// me tog la sogs mchod pa dang*// la du la sogs mthun rdzas kyis// bgegs rgyal tshogs bdag 'khor bcas mchod// dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsol// zhes bstod/ gtor ma sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ga ṇa pa ti ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol gdab bya/ rang phyag rdor du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi tshogs bdag 'khor bcas la phog pas de dag gi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te khams gsum gyi 'gro ba zas nor thams cad dbang du bsdus nas rang la thim zhing gzhal yas khang yul phyogs la sogs pa gang bar bsams la/ oṃ gam̐ ga ṇa pa ti swā hā/ brgya rtsa la sogs pa dang*/ oṃ na mastu re ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye/ oṃ gaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥ gaḥgaḥgaḥ.oṃ ga ṇa pa ti ye swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇā dhi pa ti ye/ oṃ ga ṇe shwa ra ye swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti pū dzi ta swā hā/ oṃ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma da ma da/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ ha na ha na/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ dha bha dha bha/ bhañja bhañja/ s+t+wam+bha s+t+wam+bha/ mo ha mo ha/ de hi de hi/ da da pa ya da da pa ya/ dha na sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ na maḥstu te ma hā rū dra pa tsa na ya swā hā/ zhes ci mang bzla/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma bla med kyi dbang thob pa gral la 'khod pa la/ sems can thams cad kyi zhes pa nas gsan par zhu bar spyi ltar/ gsan par bya ba'i chos ni chos ldan gyi dpal dang 'byor pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ nor lha khyad par du 'phags pa dpal tshogs kyi bdag po zhes pa 'di yin la/ de la rigs mang du yod pa la da lan 'dir jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyi tshogs bdag dkar po gtso 'khor bzhi'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la slob dpon phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba la tshogs bdag dkar po'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ gtso bo bdag la dgongs su gsol// lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po yi// lha yi dpal 'byor thob bya'i phyir// bdag la bka' drin gnang bar mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ rjes gnang gi gzhi lus bsgrub pa'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon phyag rdor du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po dmar po dmar ser dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la phog tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams dang*/ khyad par dbul zhing phongs pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i las ngan gzhan gyi 'tsho ba'i yo byad 'phrogs pa la sogs pa byang zhing dag par byas/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de la dmigs te/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams dpal tshogs kyi bdag po chags pa'i rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhes pa nas/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i dbus su gaḥyig shel dkar dwangs pa'i mdog can bsgoms pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin/

de nas slob dpon la phyag na rdo rje'i sku can du mos pa gnang bas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas tshogs bdag chags pa'i rdo rje gtso 'khor bzhi la nor lha gter bdag gis bskor ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dril gsil rol chen bya/ sngags snying po bzla/ de nas tsakli spyi bor bzhag pa'am med kyang rung*/ phyag len la mi mdzad gsungs/ mdun bskyed kyi lha bzhi las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku la thim pas mos pa mdzod/ bu 'di dkyil 'khor chen po ru// sngon du legs par zhugs zin gyi// lha chen 'di la dgongs su gsol// lha chen 'di la stsal lags kyi// lha chen 'di la rtag bzhugs nas// lha yi dpal ni stsal du gsol// 'di la bgegs ni med par mdzod// oṃ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ zhes brjod/ des lus kyi bar chad zhi bar byas te sku'i rjes gnang thob pa yin zhes brda sprad/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon phyag rdor du gsal ba'i thugs kar tshogs bdag gtso 'khor bzhi bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kar gaḥyig shel dkar gyi mdog lta bu la snying po'i sngags dang sngags ring gis bskor ba las sngags phreng 'od zer dkar po la sogs pa 'phro ba dang bcas pa chad de slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams tshogs kyi bdag por gsal ba'i sna g.yon nas zhugs/ snying ga'i gaḥyig gi mthar 'khod pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mdun bskyed du bshad pa'i snying po dang sngags ring gi rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs nas thod chang nas slob ma la ster zhing*/ lha chen dgyes pa'i dam tshig 'di// dngos grub bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun te// btung ba rin po che 'di ni// gsang ba'i dngos grub rdzas su bsngags// dpal dang gzi brjid bskyed pa'i phyir// bu khyod kyis ni myang bar gyis// oṃ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti wāka sid+dhi āḥ

zhes brjod/ des ngag gi bar chad zhi bar byas te gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i tshogs bdag gtso 'khor bzhi pa de las de 'dra ba chad de khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob ma la me tog 'thor zhing*/ lha chen mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs// 'di yi rjes su 'jug par mdzod// 'di yi rjes su zhugs nas kyang*// byin rlabs dngos grub char chen phob// oṃ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ des sems kyi bar chad zhi bar byas te thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin/ de nas gtor ma skad cig tsam gyis tshogs bdag tu gyur pa spyi bor bzhag oṃ ga ṇa pa ti swā hā/ zhes brjod/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi la sogs pa gong ma rnams dang*/ khyad par jo bo rje lha gcig dang*/ rgya brtson seng nas bzung tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi bar du byon pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar/ lha chen po khyod kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas/ 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus nas zas nor longs spyod thams cad phongs pa med cing bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod/ gtor ma lha chen por gsal ba 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gi'u wang ngam sin+dhu ras dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du thig le byas la/ 'di ni khams gsum ma lus pa// dbang du sdud par byed pa yi// rtags su dbang gi thig les gdab// dam tshig rgya 'dis brgyan par gyis// gaḥgaḥl sogs pa brgyad kyi bar dang*/ sarba rat+na sid+dhi hūm̐/ des ni phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin/

rjes gtso bos sogs 'dra/ slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la mchod bstod 'dod gsol dkyus bzhin/ yig brgya tshar gsum/ nongs pa bzod par gsol sku yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ mdun bskyed kyi dam ye gnyis ka rang la bstim/ dge ba bsngo/ shis pa brjod/ las kyi rjes bsdu/ 'di yi rjes gnang yod ces 'ga' smra yang*// tshad ldan lung dang bla ma'i gsung rgyun las// byung ba'i lha bzhi'i sgrub thabs sngags bcas kyi// rjes gnang 'khrul med u dum wā ra bzhin// zhes pa 'di ni bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa dge slong sde snod gsum pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis 'di'i bka' mi nub par bya ba'i phyir shing mo glang gi lo zla ba bdun pa'i yar tshes bcu pa'i nyin/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i 'gyur gegs sel ba'i sgrub thabs sogs dang rjes gnang gi yig rnying la brten nas dpal rtse gdong phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwar bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// //lha bzhi'i rjes gnang dang sgrub yig gi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi/ rgyal po grags pa/ byang chub 'byung gnas/ rin chen 'od zer/ yang dag sbyin pa/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba/ jo bo rje/ rgya brtson seng*/ grub thob shol po pa/ sangs rgyas dbon ston/ sangs rgyas ston tshul/ khyung tshang ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon grags tshul/ snar thang mkhan po nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ dbu ma pa grub pa brtson 'grus/ bla ma bka' bcu pa/ gung pa bkra shis bzang po/ gnyag phu ba bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal ba/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ klu dbang gling pa kun dga' rgyal po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yab sras/ rje bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan/ des bdag ngag dbang chos grags la'o// brgyud pa'i kha skong ni/

mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags nas/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la'o// //sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
